name: Ollama model chat
creator: Mike Anderson
description: Example operation that chats with a local Ollama-served LLM via LangChainAdapter

systemPrompt.description: Optional system prompt to set the AI's behavior and context

apiKey.description: Optional API key for authentication (if not provided, uses OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable)

url.description: Optional Ollama base URL. When omitted, resolves venue-side: adapters.langchain.ollamaUrl config, then the OLLAMA_BASE_URL environment variable, then http://localhost:11434. Keep agents topology-agnostic — set the venue-level knob instead of per-agent URLs

temperature.description: Sampling temperature (e.g. 0 for deterministic extraction); provider default when omitted

topP.description: Nucleus sampling top_p; provider default when omitted
